coordinate_space: Normalised visible alpha bounds; u right and v down
normal_basis: OpenGL tangent X right, Y up, Z towards camera
method: r2 manual re-annotation of the retained autumn sprite silhouettes: small visible leaf-spray ellipsoids, actual bark forks and stems, separate conifer hanging branch fans, flower disks and lily pads. Analytic vectors, normalized before 8-bit encoding. No diffuse-brightness height conversion. Each lobe uses a smoothstep outer feather to avoid geometric circular lighting seams; colors and alpha are untouched.
review_notes: All ten species re-annotated against r2 images. Leaf-spray coverage is 1.0 rather than the old 1.25, and curvature slopes are mostly 0.27-0.38 rather than large 0.62 canopy masses. Retain camera-facing shader normal_strength=0.65 and verify actual GPU relighting. Integer canvas padding does not change normalized visible-bound coordinates. Optional lobe.feather requires the supplied backward-compatible normal_map blend patch; old rigs without feather retain their original calculation.
